```
"""CSV export utilities."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from typing import Any

_SPECIALS = (",", '"', "\r", "\n")

def _quote(value: str) -> str:
    if any(ch in value for ch in _SPECIALS):
        return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return value

def export_csv(rows: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]], columns: Iterable[str]) -> str:
    selected: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for column in columns:
        if not isinstance(column, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if column in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"duplicate column name: {column!r}")
        seen.add(column)
        selected.append(column)

    header = ",".join(_quote(column) for column in selected)
    chunks: list[str] = [header, "\r\n"]
    for row in rows:
        fields: list[str] = []
        for column in selected:
            try:
                value = row[column]
            except KeyError:
                value = ""
            else:
                if value is None:
                    value = ""
                else:
                    value = str(value)
            fields.append(_quote(value))
        chunks.append(",".join(fields))
        chunks.append("\r\n")
    return "".join(chunks)
```
